sources.claim: Kyiv and historical English spelling Kiev denote the same capital
Ulaanbaatar and Ulan Bator denote the same Mongolian capital
Washington, DC is the US capital; punctuation variants normalize only

scope: Orthographic aliases and verified same-territory codes only. No historic/capital/birthplace reference relabeling. +1 alone is ambiguous against a specific +1 NPA reference and is flagged, not silently accepted.
blinding: Rules do not receive condition, person or seed. Existing cached answers were inspected for format coverage; this is not an independently blinded factual audit.
